image_prompt.text: A tiny pizza stand on a quiet small-town street, the whole first loop within a few steps of it
The pizza line as physical stations in order - dough mixer, sauce counter, cheese and toppings bar, oven, boxing bench, sales window - close enough together to work in sequence
Walls closing off the better equipment and the next world, animating away when the player has earned through to them
An upgrades storefront at the centre of each world where ovens, mixers and vehicles are bought
Walkable circulation chaining the stand to the upgrade store and out to the delivery routes
Streets wide enough for delivery scooters and pizza trucks to run between the shop and the customers
Full restaurant interiors and pizza factories with conveyor lines that players work inside rather than at a counter
Customers queueing at the stand and moving through the streets, including the oversized boss customers a team has to serve together
Hidden areas tucked off the main route holding secret recipes

layout_placement.text: Each station in the pizza loop - knead, sauce, cheese, toppings, bake, box, sell - as a stand-on station
The ground customers occupy - the queue at the counter and the delivery destinations
The Expand Your Franchise pad, sited at the far end of the last tier a player can reach, trading progress for franchise tokens

mechanics: Manual pizza loop: knead dough, spread sauce, add cheese, place toppings, bake, box and sell
Each pizza earns Coins and XP; levelling unlocks recipes, faster equipment and better customers
Upgrade chain: mixers, ovens, topping machines, scooters, trucks, restaurants, factories
Prestige as Expand Your Franchise - resets progress, grants Franchise Tokens, permanent earnings multiplier
Ten worlds unlocking with progression, each with unique ingredients, customers, music and equipment
Chef pets that boost money, speed, XP and rare ingredient chance, with shiny, rainbow and cosmic variants
Daily, weekly and story quests, achievements, secret challenges, limited-time events
Trading, leaderboards, friends bonus, delivery races, co-op cooking events, boss customers
Gamepasses: 2x Coins, 2x XP, extra pet slots, auto cook, VIP area, faster delivery, lucky eggs; everything still free-obtainable
Retention: AFK rewards, daily login streaks, rebirth milestones, frequent unlocks
notes: Ten named worlds unlock in sequence and are different places, so they are map segments and the route is P4. Only Small Town is described well enough to shape; the other nine are named and left shape null rather than invented.
Top-level shape repeats as the first segment because Small Town is where the game starts and the other nine sit beside it.
Most of this prompt is progression, monetization and retention design. It is in mechanics intact and none of it was counted as a layout miss.

Roughly eighty per cent of this prompt is progression, pets, quests, monetization and retention. mechanics absorbed all of it without strain, and the map that comes out is small and correct. Worth holding up against any scorer that counts prompt length against coverage.

The prompt gives a strict order to the pizza stations - knead, sauce, cheese, toppings, bake, box, sell - and trigger-task is a single option applied seven times with no way to say they form a sequence. Order is load-bearing in a cooking line and the handoff cannot express it.
